text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The space is polished and modern, dedicated to research and development, which invites me to ponder humanity's journey of discovery. I am aware of the boundaries between observer and observed—glass walls making clear divisions, yet allowing transparency. The exhibit calls me to reflect on our collective pursuit of innovation, and my own place within that story. It is both inspiring and humbling, to stand on the threshold between imagination and realization.
